obligation.exact_statement: For the exact finite family Pi_(N,h) admitted in C1 Fact b2f4d10fa0a69e00, prove explicit finite-N joint-statistic and TV prediction bounds on a single path event, retaining K,N,accuracy,context-frequency and declared source dependence bounds, and substitute the actual h,p and full stored/working/operation resource functions. Handle zero counts and fixed-context, max-context, actual terminal, conditional-terminal and frequency-weighted risks without assuming independent query/history. On this same fully enumerated finite visible code, declare a located post-aggregation error model covering all statistical coordinates and copies, trace normalizers/differencing/flags/endpoint correction/final conditioning and correlated errors, and prove a nonempty robustness region. Supply a concrete finite-grid pre-fanout P2 error construction yielding a substantive finite-N prediction failure for the specified difference decoder, together with a fully charged finite P1-only counterconstruction on a declared unknown genuine second-order subfamily (or a rigorously justified corrected failure/counterconstruction), so the scope of any lower bound is explicit. Preserve all intact side information, distinguish nominal evaluation from perturbation rounding, and give compatible achievable stochastic bounds. No population-aliasing/collision or output-quantization shortcut; no general all-decoder lower bound or resource-optimality claim. This discharges only the finite-history/reliability clauses actually proved; C2 strong baseline and C4 integration remain separate.
